articleTitle: A Robot Navigation Method Based on Hippocampus Place Cell Cognitive Map and Successor Representation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Communication and Computer Engineering (ICICCE)
abstract: This article is inspired by the firing mechanism of hippocampus place cells to build an environmental cognitive map, and introduces a Successor Representation (SR) model to realize robot path planning. Compared to the RL method based on value learning used in current brain navigation models, this model does not rely on specific goal points for learning cognitive maps. This paper conducted experiments on the model in a maze environment, and the results showed that the model can achieve fast switching between goal points and plan the optimal path without retraining the value function, with high flexibility.

articleTitle: A LSTM-Based Power Generation Forecasting Method For The Gird With Multiple Power Generation Modes
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Communication and Computer Engineering (ICICCE)
abstract: Forecasting generation holds substantial importance for managing load control within power grids and similar applications. The evolution of diverse power generation systems has introduced significant challenges to the precise forecasting of electricity production. To address this issue, this study introduces a forecasting technique for multiple power generation methods using the long short-term memory (LSTM) neural network, leveraging its proficiency in handling extensive sequential data, adapting to dynamic alterations, managing nonlinear relationships, and employing bidirectional learning. This LSTM-based approach aims to model and predict the output of various combined power production methodologies. Experimental evaluations reveal that, in contrast to conventional methods such as Temporal Convolutional Networks (TCN) and the autoregressive integrated moving average model (ARIMA), our proposed LSTM-based forecasting approach generates predictions with fewer errors. The model's precision increased by 55% when compared to ARIMA and by 16.83% when compared to TCN, demonstrating its superior efficacy.

articleTitle: Comparative Study of Machine Learning Methods for Nonlinearity Prediction in Nanopositioning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Communication and Computer Engineering (ICICCE)
abstract: Nanopositioning is of great importance in precision engineering and nanotechnology, but the positioning accuracy is severely deteriorated by the ubiquitous nonlinearities such as the hysteresis nonlinearity of the actuator as well as the nonlinear relation between input and output of the closed-loop control system. This paper focuses on the nonlinearity prediction in nanopositioning by using different machine learning methods. The prediction capability of three emergent machine learning models including the Gaussian process (GP), the neural network (NN) and the Koopman operator (KO) are comparatively studied by experiments on a self-made nanopositioner. The indexes of the nonlinearity prediction performance to be evaluated are the prediction accuracy and the prediction efficiency. Experimental results are summarized and discussed, which could provide a reliable selection guidance of the nonlinearity prediction methods, and thus facilitating the feedforward compensation in the precision motion control of nanopositioners.

articleTitle: High Security Frequency Hopping Communication for the Power Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Communication and Computer Engineering (ICICCE)
abstract: With the deepening of digital transformation of power industry, more and more power devices are being connected to wireless communication networks. Due to the broadcasting characteristics and openness of wireless channels, the security of power data transmission is facing serious challenges, especially for devices with limited resources. Frequency hopping (FH) technique is extensively utilized in high secure communications due to its effectiveness in mitigating interference and ensuring confidentiality. However, the increasing sophistication of electronic attacks pose a great challenge to the use of sequences aided by number theory and chaos theory. Considering the power devices with limited resources, a FH sequence generation scheme for power Internet of Things (IoT) with the aid of Eslice lightweight encryption algorithm is proposed, which achieves a balance between efficiency and security, and resist differential cryptanalysis with limited resources. Meanwhile, the proposed scheme outperforms better than the available algorithms in terms of most test metrics. Therefore, it can be seen that the proposed scheme is able to obtain secure information transmission with low resource consumption, and provide an efficient solution for wireless transmission of resource limited devices in the power IoT.

articleTitle: Automatic Identification of Ship-Ice Impact Based on SDD Model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Communication and Computer Engineering (ICICCE)
abstract: When polar ships navigate icy areas, their hulls encounter sea ice collisions, generating significant structural vibrations. These vibrations pose considerable challenges to the overall safety of the ship and the stability of shipboard equipment. Different from local structural vibration, the global motion and vibration response of the ship hull can be collectively called shipice impact, which has a greater impact on the functionality of shipboard equipment. Based on the data measured by distributed accelerometers on board the Xuelong II during its voyage in the Antarctic ice area, this paper carries out the study of icebreaking shock, and utilizes the deep learning method to identify the ice-breaking vibration events. Through spectral analysis, the ship-ice impact signal is separated, and an ice-breaking impact identification and analysis method is established. In this paper, an improved single point target detection (SSD) based model is proposed to recognize ship-ice impact in vertical acceleration. The results show that the model can accurately recognize ship-ice shock in acceleration with an accuracy of 87.15%. The model offers valuable insights for selecting polar ship equipment, thereby advancing the development of intelligent polar ships.

articleTitle: A Method of Viewshed Analysis Based on Azimuth Information Processing
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Communication and Computer Engineering (ICICCE)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy of viewshed analysis based on DEM(Digital Elevation Model, DEM) elevation data, a new viewshed analysis method in local cartesian coordinate system was proposed to solve the problem of “regularity assumption” in existing algorithms. According to the characteristics of DEM elevation data format, the definition and computing method of grid azimuth were given, and the concepts of maximum azimuth and minimum azimuth of grid were proposed to accurately reflect the azimuth information. The algorithm was able to accurately obtain all grids that affect the visibility of the target point, and then judge the visibility of the target point by comparing the pitch Angle of these grids and the target point. As a comparative verification, three different viewshed analysis algorithms were implemented. The simulation results show that the new proposed algorithm is easy to implement and can effectively complete the viewshed analysis based on DEM data. The proposed algorithm has high analysis accuracy and is suitable for the scene requiring high analysis accuracy

articleTitle: Fixed Pattern Noise Removal Based on Wavelet Transform and Semi-Calibration
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Communication and Computer Engineering (ICICCE)
abstract: Non-uniformities in pixels are prevalent in existing image sensors. In low illumination environments, the pixel nonuniformities result in the undesirable fixed-pattern noise (FPN), which severely limits the imaging capability of image sensors in dark light environments. The FPN in each pixel can be considered as a linear scaled noise pattern with an uncertain scale parameter. Aiming at the image quality degradation caused by the FPN, a noise removal algorithm based on wavelet transform and semi-calibration is proposed. The key to this work is that since wavelet transform is a linear transform, the existing linear scaled FPN model is equally valid in wavelet domains. Therefore, the scale parameter estimation in spatial domains can be accomplished in wavelet domains. To implement the parameter estimation, this paper first establishes a parameter estimation framework for minimizing Bayes risk in spatial domains. Then, combined with the noise model in wavelet domains, this paper derives the parameter estimation based on the Bayes risk minimization in wavelet domains, which is implemented by the proposed alternating iteration algorithm. With the scale parameter and the semi-calibrated noise pattern, the FPN removal from the noisy image is ultimately accomplished. The proposed method is validated in simulation experiments on BSD500 dataset as well as real-world noisy images experiments. The simulation experiment results indicate that the proposed method shows an obvious enhancement in PSNR and SSIM evaluation metrics compared with the existing algorithms. Moreover, the processing speed of the proposed method is significantly faster than the existing semi-calibration method. Finally, this paper verifies the feasibility of the proposed method by implementing real denoising experiments.

articleTitle: Learning Semantic Structure Correlation with Deep Semantic Alignment Network for Cross-Modal Retrieval
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Communication and Computer Engineering (ICICCE)
abstract: . Cross-modal retrieval is an important research in the field of multi-modal learning, which aims to map samples from different modalities into a shared feature space for comparing and retrieving samples. However, existing methods are unable to capture the potential semantic correlations and coexistence information of different modal data, resulting in lack of effective features. To address this issue, we propose a novel approach called Learning Semantic Structure Correlation with Deep Semantic Alignment Network for Cross- Modal Retrieval, which consists of multiple sub-networks that employ deep neural networks combined with a self-attentive mechanism to enhance the semantic information of the data and explore the underlying neighborhood structure in depth through graph convolutional networks. We develop an efficient aggregation strategy to construct more reliable supervised signals using multiple metrics to reduce bias. Furthermore, three contrastive learning are designed to share the same semantic information between different modalities. Extensive experiments on two widely used benchmark datasets demonstrate that our method has better performance with state-of-the-art cross-modal methods.

articleTitle: Research on the Mathematical Prediction Theory Model of User Side Light Storage Energy Generation and Its Validation Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Communication and Computer Engineering (ICICCE)
abstract: Distributed energy storage and distributed photovoltaic are currently widely used in China, but the current output level of distributed photovoltaic is closely related to factors such as sunlight duration and intensity, among which in the analysis of solar storage configuration yield based on load characteristic curves. The light intensity is based on the average daily hourly rate in the past three years, and the load curve is based on the average daily hourly rate of 15 minutes in the past year. Annual utilization hours are mostly distributed between 650 and 900 hours, and the peak of normal distribution is 700 hours. In long run, due to the high compatibility between distributed photovoltaic power generation output and peak valley electricity price policies, about 70% of the power generation occurs during peak hours. Distributed photovoltaic power generation has characteristics of non-schedulability and difficult to predict, but photovoltaic power generation has increased significantly, and its cost of electricity by source is still high.

articleTitle: Temporal-Aware Hybrid Energy Optimization: Surface Loss and Differentiable SDF in SLAM
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Communication and Computer Engineering (ICICCE)
abstract: In 3D scene reconstruction and SLAM (Simultaneous Localization and Mapping) systems, precise camera pose estimation and high-quality scene rendering are critical. Traditional approaches often overlook the temporal continuity of camera motion, potentially compromising reconstruction quality and the accuracy of pose estimation. This paper introduces a dual-energy function optimization method that integrates surface loss with differentiable Signed Distance Function (SDF) rendering. This approach enhances pose estimation and scene reconstruction quality by considering temporal continuity. Initially, we propose a surface loss function based on temporal continuity, designed to optimize inter-frame continuity during camera pose estimation. Subsequently, we develop a novel temporally continuous differentiable SDF renderer, aimed at more effectively handling dynamic changes in the scene and detail reconstruction. These two energy functions work in tandem to provide more accurate and coherent pose estimation and scene reconstruction. Experiments conducted on various challenging datasets demonstrate that our method surpasses existing techniques in reconstruction precision, detail preservation, and computational efficiency. Notably, our approach exhibits greater robustness and accuracy, especially in scenarios involving rapid movement and occlusions.

articleTitle: A Study of Climbing Strategy on Unitree Aliengo
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Communication and Computer Engineering (ICICCE)
abstract: This paper designs a novel climbing strategy that can assist in heavy-duty work even when perception is disturbed. Several touchdown times of swing feet is aimed to differentiate the ground and stairs, deciding which gait planning methods to use without the help of vision system The legged robot climb up the four steps 10 cm stairs smoothly and can tentatively measure the lifting height by contact force detection algorithm, which show the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Comparison and Analysis of the Effect of XGBoost Classification, BP Neural Network Classification and CatBoost Classification on Malware Attack Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Communication and Computer Engineering (ICICCE)
abstract: Malware attack refers to the hacker or attacker through various means, malicious software (such as viruses, trojans, spyware, etc.) implanted into the victim's computer or mobile device, in order to steal personal information, steal property, damage the system and other purposes. By comparing the effect of XGBoost classification, BP neural network classification and CatBoost classification on malware attack prediction, this paper summarizes and analyzes the advantages and disadvantages of each algorithm. The experimental results show that XGBoost classification model has the best accuracy, reaching 99.1%, while the accuracy of BP neural network classification model is 98.2%, and the accuracy of CatBoost classification model is only 82.8%. XGBoost and CatBoost are both machine learning algorithms based on gradient tree, while BP neural network is a neural network based algorithm. Comparing the three algorithms in principle, it can be found that XGBoost performs well on large-scale data, CatBoost performs well on class-unbalanced data, and BP neural networks require more training data to achieve better results. The research in this paper provides a certain research basis for the subsequent malware attack prediction, and also provides a reference for the selection of machine learning algorithms.

articleTitle: Development of Digital Twin Plat-form for UHV Converter Transformer Bushing Based on Material Simulation and Optical Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Communication and Computer Engineering (ICICCE)
abstract: UHV converter transformer bushing digital twin platform includes the typical power equipment such as valve side bushing and support structure of the UHV converter transformer. For its typical power equipment, 3D modeling is generally carried out through digital modeling, but the surface temperature and electric field strength values of the equipment can be sensed through the temperature sensors. This process includes material performance research and theoretical formula research, the material research mainly includes the relationship between the real part of the dielectric constant and temperature variation. At the same time, quantitatively describe the 3D relationship between the tangent value of the loss angle of the bushing core material of the ultra-high voltage converter transformer and the temperature, and use the neural network function RBF neural network for quantitative fitting. The fitting results indicate that the error is close to 0 in most regions, and only exists near the low-frequency range of 100Hz. The above errors are caused by the edge effect of the numerical nonlinear fitting. Within the testing range of the 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-4</sup>~ 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup>Hz, the dielectric response characteristics of pure epoxy and epoxy impregnated paper can usually be described using the modified Cole-Cole model that includes single or two relaxation processes. On the other hand, online monitoring of SF6 gas inside the casing is carried out, and the time-sharing multiplexing is used to convert the electrical signals carrying spectral information after photoelectric conversion into current and voltage, and filter and amplify them. The monitoring results indicate that when a temperature sensor is installed on the surface of the bushing, the bushing generates temperature heating under current carrying conditions. After the temperature heating, the temperature value gradually increases over time and tends to stabilize. After value stabilizes, it can reach 100 °C, and bushing oil temperature is about 80°C. The research results of article have good theoretical and engineering application value for the online monitoring of the operating status and parameters of the ultra-high voltage converter bushing.

Author Keywords: Bushing of ultra-high voltage converter transformer

articleTitle: Code Clone Detection Based on Code Semantic Enhancement Model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Communication and Computer Engineering (ICICCE)
abstract: Code clones are code fragments that are similar in composition or semantics of code statements, which can significantly improve software development efficiency and reduce costs by improving the quality of reusable code. However, existing code clone detection methods ignore the source code structure information and sequence information seriously. In this paper, we launched our research on the harder-to-break Type IV code clone detection, and propose a new method, namely Aug_Clone, to complete code clone detection task. Firstly, we utilize our published code semantic enhancement model to obtain the code semantic vector. Secondly, we perform code clone detection by calculating the similarity between these semantic vectors. At last, we evaluate our method on a large public data set, and experimental results show improvement over the state-of-the-art benchmarks, which demonstrates the effectiveness and efficiency of our method.

articleTitle: Network Intrusion Detection Based on Feature Selection and Transformer
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Communication and Computer Engineering (ICICCE)
abstract: Network intrusion detection plays an important role in the internet with huge traffic. With the rise of deep learning, scholars have begun to conduct intrusion detection based on the powerful feature extraction capabilities of deep learning and its robustness, such as convolutional neural network or Long Short-Term Memory, however, this kind of method is weak in the perception and representation of complex feature samples, resulting in poor final effect. An intrusion detection method based on feature selection and Transformer model is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the features that are most advantageous to model detection are selected by univariate feature selection and feature recursive elimination Secondly, based on Transformer architecture, an intrusion detection model is established, which encodes the traffic characteristics through the encoder in Transformer, and then classifies them using neural network, a fusion loss function is designed to accelerate the convergence of the model and improve the performance of the model. These innovative methods and the optimization of the network structure make the model achieve excellent performance, combining the performance of the model on the public data set and the self-built data set, it surpasses the current most advanced method and is an excellent intrusion detection method.

articleTitle: Application and Practice of Digital Twin Technology in Monitoring Status of Power Equipment in Converter Valve Hall
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Communication and Computer Engineering (ICICCE)
abstract: The internal power equipment of ultrahigh voltage converter valve hall is numerous and complex in structure, involving the various information elements such as the temperature and vibration. Moreover, the gas inside ultra-high voltage converter bushing is SF6 gas. Under the current over-load condition of the converter bushing, SF6 gas will decompose. This article focuses on the SF6 gas equipment inside the ultrahigh pressure converter valve hall as the research object, and analyzes specific types and content of SF6 gas decomposition products. In order to effectively detect gas content in the digital twin model of the converter transformer bushing, the new portable SF6 gas chromatograph, laser detection technology and device for HF gas, and partial discharge detection technology research using the acoustic electric coupling method are carried out, providing the effective means for onsite detection of hidden faults in operating equipment. Research has shown the digital twin technology can effectively detect the absorption spectra of gases such as O2, H20, CO, CO2, CF4, SO2, H2S, SOF2, and SO2F2. On the other hand, through digital twin partial discharge detection technology, it is effectively found that the SO2 inside the UHV converter sleeve is 29μL/L, H2S is 4μL/L, CO is 36μL/L, HF=0, detected SO2 and H2S components, determined as the insulation heating defect. The research results of paper provide theoretical and data support for operation status monitoring of SF6 gas insulated power equipment inside the ultra-high voltage converter valve hall.

articleTitle: Application Research of Power Plant Intelligent Patrol System Based on Internet of Things Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Communication and Computer Engineering (ICICCE)
abstract: With the continuous development of industrialization, power as an important support for social development, the safe operation and efficient production of power plants is particularly important. Aiming at the problems such as low efficiency and high cost of traditional inspection mode in power plant inspection, this paper designs an intelligent inspection system based on the Internet of Things technology, and conducts in-depth research on its application. The system realizes automatic acquisition, data integration and analysis of equipment data through the Internet of Things technology, and optimizes the data transmission channel. The test results show that the application of this intelligent inspection system can greatly improve the efficiency and accuracy of power plant inspection, reduce operation and maintenance costs, and provide strong support for the safe and stable operation of power plants.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Drug Delivery Vehicle Based on YOLOv5 for Digital Recognition and Automatic Tracking
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Communication and Computer Engineering (ICICCE)
abstract: Under the influence of the novel coronavirus epidemic, it is very important to strengthen the prevention and control of nosocomial infection. In order to effectively reduce the possibility of cross-infection, reduce the work burden of medical personnel, and prevent medical personnel from being exposed to risky environments, this paper proposes a design scheme of intelligent drug delivery car. This design uses the STM32F103RCT6 chip as the main control chip of the drug delivery car, and uses the V831 AI chip of Quanzhi Technology Company for digital recognition and automatic path finding. The angle of the car is obtained in real-time through the MPU6050 three-axis gyroscope, and the real-time speed of the car is obtained through the Hall sensor, achieving the positioning of the car and intelligent transportation of drugs. Finally, multiple car collaborative transportation functions are achieved through the communication module. With the help of the Python framework and the YOLOv5 object detection algorithm, the model is trained by inputting pre-processed training set data. Then, the model is cropped and quantified, and the YOLOv5 algorithm's decode solution code is written on V831. Finally, the predicted results of the model, which are the numbers to be recognized, are obtained. The resulting data is sent to the main control chip for digital recognition.

articleTitle: Research and Exploration of the Data Security Compliance Inspection Technology Based on the Large-Scale Call Platform of the Customer Service Center
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Communication and Computer Engineering (ICICCE)
abstract: With the rapid development of large call platforms in customer service centers, the processing and storage of a large number of sensitive information makes data security and compliance a crucial issue. The purpose of this paper is to explore the data security and compliance inspection technology based on the large call platform to ensure the privacy and integrity of the data while meeting the requirements of laws and regulations. Through in-depth research and analysis, combined with existing technical means, to provide practical solutions for the data security compliance of the call platform.

articleTitle: Privacy-Preserving, Low-Storage, and High-Quality Image Processing in IoT and Clouds
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Communication and Computer Engineering (ICICCE)
abstract: In Internet of Things (IoT) and clouds, while many image processing tasks are outsourced to third party cloud computing platforms, image processing in encrypted domain is needed in many services for data confidentiality and privacy-preserving purposes. There are many solutions for image scaling, cropping and color correction in this context. However, most of the solutions are not compatible with each other and there are few solutions supporting all these operations. In this paper, we propose a scheme that supports image scaling, cropping, and color correction in encrypted domain with minimum storage overhead. An optional improvement solution is added for a conditional quality issue in certain circumstances. Analysis shows storage requirement is drastically reduced while performance otherwise remains unchanged.

articleTitle: A Product Classification Recognition Model Based on Correlation Analysis and a Combination of Multiple Machine Learning Classification Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Communication and Computer Engineering (ICICCE)
abstract: This article mainly studies the relationship between the composition and weathering of ancient glass products of different types, patterns and colors. Firstly, the data were preprocessed to exclude unreasonable data, and then the correlation analysis model and difference analysis model were used to fit the relationship between the weathering of the glass relics surface and the types, decorations and colors of the glass. Secondly, the missing data is processed, filled with mathematical expectations, and classified by random forest classification method, based on alumina. Then, by drawing the importance moving average reference graph, calculating the mathematical expectation and standard deviation, the acceptable domain is obtained, and the standard deviation graph is drawn to verify the rationality and sensitivity of the classification results. Then, Ridge regression predictive analysis is used to analyze the training group, and the trained model is used to classify the test group, and the classification results are obtained. Finally, the model is verified according to the prediction accuracy obtained by training. This paper mainly introduces the principle of correlation analysis algorithm and ridge regression method, and describes how to apply these methods to solve the weathering problem of ancient relics. Pearson correlation analysis is a statistical method used to measure the strength of the linear relationship between two variables, while Ridge regression is a regression analysis method used to deal with multicollinearity problems. These algorithms have been effectively applied in this paper, which can provide reference for other research on the weathering of ancient relics.

articleTitle: Kinematic Analysis of Tractor-Trailer Mobile Robot on a Sphere
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Communication and Computer Engineering (ICICCE)
abstract: In order to study the motion control problem of a Tractor-Trailer Mobile Robot (TTWMR) on a spherical container, the kinematics characteristics of the robot on the sphere were analyzed. The position and orientation of a TTWMR system are described using a generalized coordinate vector composed of six variables. Based on the holonomic and nonholonomic constraints imposed on the system, a velocity transfer matrix for adjacent robots in a wheeled multi-body robot system is proposed, and a kinematics model for the motion of a TTWMR on a sphere is established. The kinematic model is theoretically simulated using Matlab and virtually simulated using Adams for robot prototypes. By comparing the results of the theoretical simulation with the virtual simulation, the accuracy of the model is validated, providing a theoretical foundation for the control of trailer mobile robots on a sphere and practical insights for their practical application.

articleTitle: Application and Practice of Wireless LAN Security Enhancement Technology Based on WAPI
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Communication and Computer Engineering (ICICCE)
abstract: With the rapid development of wireless communication technology, wireless LAN has become an indispensable part of people's life and work. However, due to the characteristics of wireless signal, the security problem of wireless local area network is becoming increasingly prominent. Therefore, this paper discusses the application and practice of security enhancement technology based on WAPI (Wireless LAN Authentication Protocol) in wireless LAN. By introducing the security enhancement mechanism of WAPI in detail, including identity authentication, data encryption, key generation and distribution, this paper reveals how to ensure the confidentiality, integrity and reliability of wireless communication through these technologies. Through the actual application scenario and data comparison, the actual effect and advantage of WAPI technology are demonstrated, and a powerful solution is provided for improving the security of wireless LAN.

articleTitle: Prompt-enhanced Federated Learning for Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Communication and Computer Engineering (ICICCE)
abstract: Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis (ABSA) involves fine-grained sentiment classification at the entity level, where sentences may contain multiple aspects. Despite notable progress in ABSA with the advent of deep learning and pre-trained language models, data privacy concerns often impede the sharing of sensitive research data. Federated learning (FL) has emerged as a solution, enabling decentralized model training without direct access to raw datasets. However, traditional FL struggles with text data heterogeneity, particularly in ABSA tasks reliant on domain-specific information. This paper presents Prompt-enhanced Federated Learning (PFL) for Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis. PFL combines FL's privacy-preserving capabilities with prompt tuning. Our model encrypts data using FL to ensure data privacy and exploits external linguistic features for better data representation. Additionally, PFL augments the precision of sentiment analysis by leveraging advanced techniques such as Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformer (BERT) for contextual comprehension and Graph Convolutional Network (GCN) for graphical representation, named PFL-GCN. Comprehensive experiments on three benchmark datasets demonstrate PFL-GCN's competitive performance compared to state-of-the-art models while preserving data privacy and enhancing results with prompt tuning. This approach advances sentiment analysis and effectively addresses critical data privacy and security concerns in FL, rendering it well-suited for practical applications that necessitate the rigorous safeguarding of sensitive data.

articleTitle: Resource Optimization-Oriented Method for Generating Cooperative Interference Strategies
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Communication and Computer Engineering (ICICCE)
abstract: The generation of effective jamming strategies stands as a critical imperative in the realm of communication countermeasures. A comparative analysis of extant jamming strategy generation methods reveals a scarcity of research that simultaneously addresses the optimization of cooperative jamming effectiveness and the judicious allocation of resources, with a focus on resource minimization. In light of these observations, this study employs a multifaceted approach, harnessing machine learning and allied methodologies, to discern potential behavioral patterns within communication stations. Specifically, we construct a scenario of communication confrontation, featuring multiple jammers and multiple communication stations. Subsequently, we establish a model for the generation of cooperative jamming strategies, leveraging a double deep Q-network. Moreover, we introduce a dual-dynamic penalty function that synergizes with the double deep Q-network. This combined approach aids the model in searching for optimal solutions under specific constraints throughout the interference process's various stages. In doing so, the model strives to optimize the utilization of interference resources while ensuring effective cooperative interference. Simulation results substantiate the efficacy of the proposed approach. The double deep Q-network algorithm, when integrated with the dual dynamic penalty function, significantly enhances interference effectiveness. Furthermore, it achieves a noteworthy 25% reduction in interference resource consumption compared to an unconstrained algorithm.

articleTitle: Application Research and Progress of BP Neural Network Prediction Model Optimized by Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Communication and Computer Engineering (ICICCE)
abstract: The principle of BP neural network optimized by genetic algorithm is introduced, and the methods and general steps for solving conventional problems are given. The improvement of component optimization and coding technology, fitness function calibration, genetic operator, control parameter selection and algorithm structure optimization in recent years are discussed. The application in the fields of finance, construction engineering, material science, electric power, computer science, water conservancy and agronomy, medicine and environmental science is described. The future development trend and research direction of genetic neural network in data prediction are summarized.

articleTitle: Privacy Armor for IoT: A Fusion Framework of Blockchain and LSTM for Data Security
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent Communication and Computer Engineering (ICICCE)
abstract: The rapid development of the Internet of Things (IoT) has led to an exponential increase in the number of connected devices and sensors, resulting in the generation of a massive volume of data. However, ensuring the security of this data has become a critical concern. This paper proposes an IoT data security framework that utilizes both blockchain and LSTM. The framework adopts a distributed cloud-fog-IoT architecture, utilizing IPFS for off-chain storage. This combination guarantees data immutability, traceability, and verifiability. To ensure node trustworthiness and data privacy, the framework incorporates a privacy protection module based on blockchain and principal component analysis. Moreover, a LSTM-based security module is introduced to detect anomalous behavior in heterogeneous networks. Experimental results indicate that this framework not only provides robust security measures but also significantly reduces the operational costs associated with blockchain technology,
